name: forget
description: DELETE/REMOVE one or more memories permanently by explicit ID. Use a memory ID already visible in the current conversation or injected memory context when it clearly identifies the intended record; otherwise call search_memory or semantic_recall first. If identification is missing or ambiguous, do not delete. This tool accepts only memory_id or memory_ids and never searches or fuzzy-matches. This is for DELETION - use update_memory if you need to CHANGE a value instead.

memory_id.description: Exact memory ID from visible context or a prior search_memory or semantic_recall lookup.

memory_ids.description: Multiple memory IDs to delete in one call. Use this when the user names more than one memory ID. Hard capped at 10 IDs for safety.
